description: Generate the <head> HTML for SEO and social sharing: <title>, meta description, canonical link, Open Graph (og:type, url, title, description, image + alt, site_name, locale) and X/Twitter card tags. All values are HTML-escaped. Also checks lengths (title 30–60, description 70–160 characters), URLs and the @handle, and shows how Google, Facebook and X would truncate the title and description. URLs without a scheme get https://. Optionally writes the tags to an .html file. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/meta-tags/

imageAlt.description: Alt text for the share image.

output.description: Where to write the result: a file path, or a folder ending in "/". Default: the server output folder (a temp folder unless --out-dir is set).

twitter.description: X/Twitter handle: "@name", "name" or a profile URL.

type.description: og:type, e.g. website, article, product, profile. Default website.

name: meta_tags_generate
title: Meta tags generator
